incident-bot: Pager: P0 - inference-canary errors spiking (service=inference-canary, 40% 5xx over last 2m) — paging sam (oncall) and maria (sre)

sam (oncall): i'm on it, watching metrics and logs, switching to #eng-oncall for deeper access

maria (sre): grabbing kube events and recent deploy history, any traffic changes?
sam (oncall): deploy window at 22:10 UTC pushed a canary of encoder-v2 -> ~10% traffic, immediately saw error rate climb
elain (eng-runtime): tagging in — the canary had a memory config change (heap-limit increased) and a new affinity rule for GPUs

jess (support): customers A and B reported timeouts, CS triage says elevated latency -> errors for specific model requests

maria (sre): running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=inference-canary -o wide`

maria (sre): ```
NAME                                      READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
inference-canary-5fd8c               0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   6          8m
inference-canary-6a7b2               1/1     Running            0          7m
```

sam (oncall): describe on the crashing pod to see crashloop reason
maria (sre): ```
$ kubectl describe pod inference-canary-5fd8c -n inference
Containers:
  encoder:
    Image: registry/redwood/encoder:v2
    State: Waiting
      Reason: OOMKilled
    Last State: Terminated
      Reason: OOMKilled
    Limits:
      memory: 1Gi
    Requests:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 512Mi
Events:
  Normal  Pulling    6m
  Normal  Pulled     6m
  Warning BackOff   5m   kubelet
```

tony (infra): HPA is configured with `minReplicas: 0` for canaries? that sounds wrong. someone changed it in the deploy manifest?

elaine (eng-runtime): checking the canary manifest in the release PR... i see `hpa.minReplicas: 0` and `targetMemoryUtilization: 80`. canary gets marked for scale-to-zero during node drain windows

sam (oncall): we also have a node drain in progress in eu-west-1 due to maintenance, pods are being evicted; combined with HPA=0 can cause pods not to be rescheduled -> traffic piling on remaining pods -> OOMs

maria (sre): good catch. impact: 10% traffic routed to canary, then autoscaler scaled it down while eviction happened -> sudden pressure on the remaining canary instance -> OOM loops -> 5xx. customer impact: some requests errored, approx 0.4% of total platform requests but concentrated on critical customers.

jess (support): CS notified customers A/B with short blurb. Would an immediate rollback help?

elaine (eng-runtime): recommended short-term: kill the canary variant traffic (feature flag kill) and scale down the canary deployment to 0 until fix. long-term: fix HPA manifest to `minReplicas: 1` for canaries during drain windows.

sam (oncall): @tony can you patch the routing to remove canary? we have a kill-switch flag `flags.canary_encoder_v2`

tony (infra): doing it now — `./tools/flag-set flags.canary_encoder_v2 false --env=prod`

incident-bot: Action executed: flags.canary_encoder_v2 set to false by tony at 2026-03-17T22:07:30Z

elain (eng-runtime): confirming no more canary traffic in routing logs — switching traffic off

maria (sre): scaling canary deployment to 0 to stop crashloops: `kubectl scale deploy inference-canary --replicas=0 -n inference`
sam (oncall): running deploy rollback as an alternate mitigation: `redwoodctl rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=stable`

maria (sre): post-mitigation checks: error rate falling back to baseline, CPU/mem pressure on remaining inferencers normalizing
jess (support): updating customers: "We've rolled back the canary and isolated the issue. Some requests earlier may have failed; we are monitoring and will follow up." :white_check_mark:

elaine (eng-runtime): root cause summary draft: combination of (a) inadvertent `minReplicas: 0` for canary HPA in release manifest, (b) concurrent node drain in eu-west-1 causing evictions, and (c) traffic spike to remaining pod causing OOM and crashloops. will open PR to enforce minReplicas>=1 and add drain-aware policy.
tony (infra): follow-ups: 1) add CI check for HPA minReplicas for canaries 2) add temp guard in routing to avoid sending traffic to canaries during cluster maintenance 3) add alert if HPA minReplicas=0 for non-zero traffic rules

sam (oncall): incident-> P1 remediated, paging suppressed. leaving follow-up tasks assigned to eng-runtime and infra. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, summary="Canary rolled back and flagged; HPA manifest misconfig + node drain led to crashloops and 5xx spike" — Incident will be archived after postmortem plan is created.
